description: This file contains a class definition for LDAPServerConfig within the OrangeHRM LDAP testing namespace. It models LDAP server configuration data with properties like host, port, encryption, admin credentials, and provides a static method to instantiate an object from an array.

classes.name: LDAPServerConfig
classes.description: Represents LDAP server configuration data with properties such as host, port, encryption method, admin distinguished name, and admin password. Includes a static method to create an instance from an array of configuration data.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Creates an LDAPServerConfig object from an associative array of server configuration parameters.
